channel.title: Release · projectious.work
channel.description: Documentation, release history and marketing pages on the projectious.work brand system.

item.title: v0.3.5 — readable dark selections and solid navigation
item.description: Dark surfaces now use accessible selection colors, and the sticky header remains visually separate from scrolling content.

item.title: v0.3.4 — public data-driven composition APIs
item.description: Consumers can compose badges, cards, tables and application shells from Hugo data through stable theme partials.

item.title: v0.3.3 — consolidated features and versatile examples
item.description: Feature documentation now covers every public shortcode, while new full-page examples demonstrate the theme beyond documentation sites.

item.title: v0.3.2 — public hooks for site-owned assets
item.description: Consuming sites can now append Hugo-piped CSS and JavaScript without replacing the theme's internal pipelines.

item.title: v0.3.1 — revised design system and complete theme guidance
item.description: The finalized design system, reliable diagrams and comprehensive multilingual guidance arrive in this patch release.

item.title: v0.3.0 — pinned runtimes, section-filtered search, command palette
item.description: Runtime assets are version-pinned, search indexes headings, and every page action sits in one row.

item.title: v0.2.0 — navy dark mode and the accessibility layer
item.description: Dark mode moves onto the midnight scale, and every accessibility setting became opt-in.
